neighbours.label: the name Buffon (its final piece 'on' after ' Buff'), versus similar-looking words and other naturalists' names
fire: Many readers in Paris first learned natural history from Buffon and his assistants.
The count of Buffon ran the royal garden for nearly fifty years.
In his letters, Darwin mentions Buffon as an early thinker on change in species.
Visitors to the museum can see a statue of Buffon near the main gate.
The encyclopedia by Buffon filled dozens of volumes on animals and minerals.
Historians still argue about how much Buffon believed in evolution.
A young Lamarck worked as a tutor for the son of Buffon in the 1780s.
The botanist read Buffon every night by candlelight as a student.
quiet: Many readers in Paris first learned natural history from Cuvier and his assistants.
The count of Bourbon ran the royal estate for nearly fifty years.
In his letters, Darwin mentions Lyell as an early thinker on change in the earth.
Visitors to the museum can see a statue of a buffalo near the main gate.
The encyclopedia by Diderot filled dozens of volumes on arts and trades.
Historians still argue about how much Linnaeus believed in fixed species.
A young Lamarck worked as a tutor for the son of a buffoon in a traveling show.
The botanist read Linnaeus every night by candlelight as a student.
